title: Maximize Happiness of Selected Children
description:
You are given an array happiness and an integer k.

Each element represents the happiness of a child.

You will select k children, one per turn.

Rules:

When you pick a child, you gain their current happiness
After each pick, all remaining (unpicked) children:
lose 1 happiness
but never go below 0

Your task:

Choose k children to maximize total happiness

Example 1
Input: [1,2,3], k = 2
Output: 4

Example 2
Input: [1,1,1,1], k = 2
Output: 1

Example 3
Input: [2,3,4,5], k = 1
Output: 5

Constraints:

1 <= n <= 2 * 10^5
1 <= happiness[i] <= 10^8
1 <= k <= n
input_format: Read from standard input. Format details depends on the problem.
constraints: Please read problem description for constraints.
